item.blurb: Dextr AI Raises $6.7 Mn In Seed Funding - BW Disrupt. Dextr AI Raises $6.7 Mn In Seed Funding  BW Disrupt

HIFI Raises $37M to Connect Regulated Banking Directly to Stablecoins. Zach Walsh has already picked his Halloween costume: trapped liquidity. It is the one thing that spooks the cofounder and CEO of HIFI, whose platform moves money and tokenized assets around the clock instead of on a bank's schedule. With $7B+ in annualized volume, a seat in DTCC's July tokenized trades, and a new Visa partnership, HIFI just landed $37M to push further. Find out why Walsh sees payments, cards, and capital mark
